NPT-3202                                                                                                             about:srcdoc  
  
  
  Exam Date & Time: 27-Jun-2024 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MIT BLR - BTech VI Semester - End Semester Makeup Examination - June -2024  
  Introduction to Internet of Things [NPT-3202]  
  Marks: 50                                                                             Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Analyze the header structure of IPv4 with a suitable diagram.  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)      Illustrate the MQTT components and methods.                                            (3)  
  C)      Explain the Constrained Application Protocol with an example.                          (3)  
  2)           Describe the difference between a sensor and a transducer, and provide examples of  
  each. How do they contribute to the functionality of IoT devices?  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Illustrate the Features and addressing of 6LoWPANs.                                    (5)  
  3)           Illustrate the device and user interoperability with an example.  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)      Outline the sketch structure and functions of Arduino.                                 (3)  
  C)      Evaluate and justify the Blinking LED principles with suitable code snippet.           (3)  
  4)           Analyze the role of extensive features of the Arduino ecosystem.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Outline the Arduino program for the Traffic Control System with a suitable sketch      (5)  
  5)           Critically evaluate the NIST Visual Model of Cloud Computing in terms of its  
  effectiveness in conceptualizing the various service models.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Illustrate the comparison of different deployment models in the cloud.                 (5)
